com.tpl.acknowledgement.action: Nothing is needed from you. The case team sorts the case by the date below, then tells you when to expect an answer.
com.tpl.acknowledgement.consequence: Nothing changes. The case goes on. Keep the reference {case} to follow it.
com.tpl.acknowledgement.subject: We received case {case}, which you raised at {submittedAt}.
com.tpl.appeal_lapse.action: Nothing is needed from you. The appeal is not treated as dismissed, and the person responsible has been told to take it forward.
com.tpl.appeal_lapse.consequence: The published period ended on the date below. No outcome has been decided on the appeal.
com.tpl.appeal_lapse.subject: Appeal {appeal} on case {case} has passed its published period with no outcome.
com.tpl.appeal_outcome.action: Read the outcome with the reference {case}. It says what further route is open to you, if any.
com.tpl.appeal_outcome.consequence: The outcome applies from the date below.
com.tpl.appeal_outcome.subject: Your appeal on case {case} has been decided: {outcome}.
com.tpl.application_acknowledgement.acti: Nothing more is needed from you. The application is reviewed and you are told the next step by the date below.
com.tpl.application_acknowledgement.cons: Nothing changes. Keep the reference {application} to follow it.
com.tpl.application_closure.action: If you still need to register, start a new application with: {missing}.
com.tpl.application_closure.consequence: This application is no longer considered.
com.tpl.application_closure.subject: Application {application} for {premises} has been closed as incomplete.
com.tpl.application_decision.action: Read the decision and its explanation under Registration in the premises portal. If you disagree, you can ask for it to be reconsidered.
com.tpl.application_decision.consequence: The decision applies as stated. The date below is the first date it sets, where it sets one.
com.tpl.application_decision.subject: Application {application} for {premises} has been decided: {outcome}.
com.tpl.application_evidence_request.act: Send these from Registration in the premises portal: {items}.
com.tpl.application_evidence_request.con: If they have not all arrived by the date, the application may be closed as incomplete.
com.tpl.application_evidence_request.sub: Application {application} for {premises}: we need more documents.
com.tpl.case_status_change.action: The reason recorded: “{reason}”. If you think this is wrong, contact the office below.
com.tpl.case_status_change.consequence: The case goes on with its new status. The date below is the last day to respond, if you wish to.
com.tpl.case_status_change.subject: Case {case} {state}.
com.tpl.certification_refusal.action: See the criterion not met: {criterion}. You may apply again once it is met.
com.tpl.certification_refusal.consequenc: This supplier's devices cannot be used as a RightOne Player until certified.
com.tpl.certification_refusal.subject: Device certification {certification} from {supplier} was refused under version {version} of the criteria.
com.tpl.credential_revocation.action: Nothing is needed from you for the revocation to take effect. To use the device again, pair it with a new pairing code.
com.tpl.credential_revocation.consequenc: From that time the device receives no music and sends no playback evidence.
com.tpl.credential_revocation.subject: The credential of device {device} at {premises} has been revoked from {effective}. Reason: {event}.
com.tpl.decision.action: Read the decision with the reference {case}. If you disagree, you can challenge it by the date below.
com.tpl.decision.consequence: After that date a challenge is still accepted, and recorded as late.
com.tpl.decision.subject: Case {case} has been decided.
com.tpl.device_loss_alert.action: Check the evidence held ({quarantined}) and the revocation of the device's credential.
com.tpl.device_loss_alert.consequence: From the reported time the device receives no music and its evidence is held.
com.tpl.device_loss_alert.subject: Device {device} has been reported {condition}.
com.tpl.engagement_capability_change.act: Nothing is needed from you. The points you hold do not change.
com.tpl.engagement_capability_change.con: The change applies from the date below to every party taking part.
com.tpl.engagement_disclosure.action: Read the new disclosure in the premises portal before you take part again.
com.tpl.engagement_disclosure.consequenc: From that date, taking part counts under the new disclosure.
com.tpl.engagement_disclosure.subject: Engagement disclosure version {disclosure} takes effect at {effectiveFrom}.
com.tpl.evidence_deadline_alert.action: {officer}, review the case and decide the next step.
com.tpl.evidence_deadline_alert.conseque: What did not arrive is recorded as not supplied by the deadline, and the case is decided on what there is.
com.tpl.evidence_deadline_alert.subject: Case {case}: the deadline for {item} has passed with nothing received.
com.tpl.evidence_quarantine.action: Nothing is needed from you. The evidence is not deleted. The evidence owner decides whether it is kept apart or used.
com.tpl.evidence_quarantine.consequence: While held, these plays are not counted on the premises' record.
com.tpl.evidence_quarantine.subject: Playback evidence from device {device} is being held: {events} plays, under disposition {disposition}.
com.tpl.evidence_request.action: Send {item} to the case team, quoting {case}.
com.tpl.evidence_request.consequence: The case is decided on what we have, and the decision says what could not be established.
com.tpl.evidence_request.subject: Case {case}: we need {item}.
com.tpl.evidence_request_cancellation.ac: You do not need to send it. Anything you have already sent stays on the case file.
com.tpl.evidence_request_cancellation.co: Nothing changes. The case goes on as before.
com.tpl.evidence_response.action: {officer}, read the response and record what it settles in the case.
com.tpl.evidence_response.consequence: The case's targets run as before.
com.tpl.evidence_response.subject: Case {case}: a response about {item} has arrived.
com.tpl.expected_decision_date.action: Nothing is needed from you. If more documents are needed, a separate notice will ask for them.
com.tpl.expected_decision_date.consequen: If the decision comes later than this date, the application goes on and you are told why.
com.tpl.expected_decision_date.subject: Application {application} for {premises}: the decision is expected by the date below.
com.tpl.expiry.action: Renew it, or tell us you are closing.
com.tpl.expiry.consequence: The record lapses and the premises is no longer covered.
com.tpl.expiry.subject: Status record {record} for {premises} is about to expire.
com.tpl.inspection_record.action: Read the record in the premises portal. If something in it is wrong, contact the office below by the date below.
com.tpl.inspection_record.consequence: The record is the official account of this inspection.
com.tpl.inspection_record.subject: Inspection record {record} (version {version}) for {premises} has been made.
com.tpl.newsletter.subject: RightOne newsletter: {title}.
com.tpl.outstanding_amount.action: Pay this fee from Payments in the premises portal.
com.tpl.outstanding_amount.consequence: No status record is issued for the premises under this decision until the fee is paid.
com.tpl.outstanding_amount.subject: The fee under decision {decision} for {premises}: {amount}.
com.tpl.pairing_authorisation.action: Enter the code on the device before it expires. If nobody at the premises asked for it, revoke it in the premises portal.
com.tpl.pairing_authorisation.consequenc: After that time the code no longer works, and a new one has to be issued. This notice does not show the code.
com.tpl.pairing_authorisation.subject: A device pairing code for {premises} was issued at the request of {asked}, for {purpose}. It expires at {expires}.
com.tpl.payment_reminder.action: Pay it from Payments in the premises portal by the date below.
com.tpl.payment_reminder.consequence: After that date the fee is recorded as unpaid and you are sent a notice of the amount owed.
com.tpl.payment_reminder.subject: The fee under decision {decision} for {premises}: {amount}, due on the date below.
com.tpl.schedule_fallback.action: Put eligible tracks in {playlist}, or change the schedule for this period.
com.tpl.schedule_fallback.consequence: Until you change it, this period stays as described above.
com.tpl.schedule_fallback.subject: {premises}'s schedule for {period} could not play {playlist}, and {resolvedTo}.
com.tpl.service_ending_confirmation.acti: Nothing more is needed from you. The service's history is kept after it ends.
com.tpl.service_ending_confirmation.cons: From 00:00 on that date, delivery and playback under this service stop.
com.tpl.service_ending_confirmation.subj: Your request to end RightOne Player service {service} is recorded. The service ends on the date below.
com.tpl.service_enforcement.action: See the ground, the remedy and what reinstatement needs under Player in the premises portal, or ask the contact below.
com.tpl.service_enforcement.consequence: From that date the service's public status changes with it, and the Player plays under this action.
com.tpl.service_enforcement.subject: RightOne Player service {service} {action} from the date below.
com.tpl.service_reinstatement.consequenc: From that date the service runs as before and its public status is active again.
com.tpl.service_reinstatement.subject: RightOne Player service {service} is reinstated from the date below.
com.tpl.service_scope_exit.action: Nothing is needed from you. This is not an enforcement action.
com.tpl.service_scope_exit.consequence: From the date below the Player stops playing under this service. Its history is kept.
com.tpl.service_scope_exit.subject: RightOne Player service {service} ends because the premises is no longer within the direct-licence scope.
com.tpl.status_change.action: See the record under Status records in the premises portal.
com.tpl.status_change.consequence: The new status applies from the date below.
com.tpl.status_change.subject: Status record {record} for {premises} is now {status}.
com.tpl.track_change.action: Remove the track from these playlists: {playlists}. Schedules that play them: {schedules}.
com.tpl.track_change.consequence: The Player skips the track. A time slot whose playlist has no eligible track left plays the default playlist.
com.tpl.track_change.subject: {track} ({artist}) in the playlists of {premises} {change}. {effect}
